corrections_after_observed_failures: The reception projection constrained outgoing aim as well as movement. Action aiming now has an independent body-relative frame and retains the last selected aim through taps and stick release.

Lateral header sources could be classified as upper-arm contacts by nearest utility origins. Named native headers now require actual weighted head skin; their trajectory and reach remain checked by the original strict contact gate.
The aerial shot solver computed a refined direction without passing it into GetShotVector. The existing speed, difficulty and spin solver now receives that refined direction.

Both old preparation/follow-through half-sines reached zero at contact. The connected upper-body layer now carries effort through contact and nine real pose-curve families cover compact, lateral, airborne, drive, sweep, loft, turn, first-time and braced responses.
